purpose: Emit precise bytes for the BMO-X2 Ring 0 kernel
policy: Implement the instructions and effects required by a kernel milestone; do not claim the whole x86 instruction set.

features.need: Bounded source, names, diagnostics and source locations
features.evidence: metal64 frontend and rejection bank; Native frontend has its own grammar

features.need: CPU-width integers with defined arithmetic and explicit traps
features.evidence: metal64 has checked constants; Native has checked runtime u64; sized runtime types remain pending
Native implements them; privileged kernel profile has not been derived or executed

features.need: Records, fixed arrays, sizes and alignment for hardware structures
features.evidence: No general kernel data-layout contract implemented yet

features.need: Addresses, access widths, regions, lifetimes and permissions
features.evidence: Native checked buffers are a reference; they are not general kernel pointers

features.need: Explicit volatile device reads/writes and ordering
features.evidence: No kernel MMIO language contract implemented

features.need: CPUID, control registers, MSRs, ports and declared CPU preconditions
features.evidence: Only add an encoding after a milestone requires it and it has an independent byte vector

features.need: Descriptor tables, entry frames, stack alignment and exception return
features.evidence: No IDT/TSS entry implementation in BMO-X2

features.need: Enter Ring 3 and return through a checked, versioned syscall ABI
features.evidence: No BMO-X2 transition or syscall implementation

features.need: Defined atomics, barriers and synchronization before concurrency
features.evidence: Single-CPU bring-up first; no SMP claim

features.need: Own x86-64 encoding for required registers, operands and instructions
features.evidence: metal64 and Native have bounded encoders; no complete privileged backend

features.need: Units, symbols, relocations, entry and RX/RW/NX image regions
features.evidence: FAGRAW64 and Native module formats are references, not a chosen BMO-X2 kernel image

features.need: Check code, data, control flow and trap declarations before publication
features.evidence: Separate existing template verifiers; every new instruction requires coverage

features.need: Frozen source to IR to exact HEX bytes, with hashes and visible maps
features.evidence: metal64 source/IR/HEX and SG map exist; new kernel effects still need mapping

features.need: Execute without implicit Linux or Windows services
features.evidence: Native pure modules exist; entry.casm still requires the metal64 loader service table

features.need: Host vectors, isolated QEMU execution and later hardware evidence
features.evidence: Genesis G1: seven fresh QEMU/OVMF cases; exact loaded body, framebuffer, return, final CPL=0/HLT=1. Physical BMO-X2 boot and autonomous kernel remain pending.
